summary: JBDI Holdings, a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed container reconditioning firm, agreed on October 12, 2026 to acquire 100% of BVI-based Glorian Capital, parent of London technology company Flicknmix, which operates AI-native social platform ZYMIX, from listed sellers for $900 million. Consideration is payable solely through senior unsecured perpetual zero-coupon convertible notes issued to the sellers at closing, convertible at $1.00 per share into ordinary or Class A ordinary shares. Voting-power caps limit each holder and aggregate noteholder votes to 40%; Nasdaq Rule 5635 shareholder approval applies unless the company relies on home country practice. A dual-class shareholder vote is set for October 22, 2026. Watch conversion-driven dilution and financing feasibility given the $900 million price against the tiny operating business.
